```python
import DREAM
from DREAM import DREAMSettings, runiface
from DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid import RadialGrid
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import TransportSettings
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.Ions import Ions
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.ColdElectrons import ColdElectrons
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.ElectricField import ElectricField
from DREAM.Settings.Equations.HotElectronDistribution import HotElectronDistribution
from DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper import TimeStepper

# Simulation parameters
nr = 10
r0 = 0.0
r1 = 0.2
nt = 50
tmax = 1e-3
dt = tmax / nt
Te0 = 10  # Initial cold electron temperature [eV]
Te1 = 100  # Final cold electron temperature [eV]
E_field = 0.1  # Electric field [V/m]
ion_species = [{'name': 'D', 'Z': 1, 'n': 1e19}]  # Deuterium, 1e19 m^-3

# Transport parameters
D_scalar = 1.0  # Constant scalar diffusion coefficient [m^2/s]
transport_modes = ['DIFFUSION', 'RECHESTERROSENBLUTH', 'NONE']
enable_hottail = [True, False]

for mode in transport_modes:
    for hottail in enable_hottail:
        ds = DREAMSettings()

        # Radial grid
        ds.radialgrid.setB0(2.0)
        ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(r1)
        ds.radialgrid.setNr(nr)

        # Time stepper
        ds.timestep.setTmax(tmax)
        ds.timestep.setNt(nt)

        # Ions
        for ion in ion_species:
            ds.eqsys.ions.addIon(name=ion['name'], Z=ion['Z'], n=ion['n'])

        # Cold electron temperature
        ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(Te0)
        ds.eqsys.T_cold.setPrescribedData(Te1)
        ds.eqsys.T_cold.setType(ColdElectrons.TYPE_PRESCRIBED)

        # Electric field
        ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(E_field)
        ds.eqsys.E_field.setPrescribedData(E_field)
        ds.eqsys.E_field.setType(ElectricField.TYPE_PRESCRIBED)

        # Hot tail grid
        ds.hottail.setEnabled(hottail)
        if hottail:
            ds.hottail.setNxi(20)
            ds.hottail.setNp(40)
            ds.hottail.setPmax(1.0)

        # Transport settings
        if mode == 'DIFFUSION':
            ds.eqsys.n_re.transport.prescribeDiffusion(D_scalar)
            ds.eqsys.n_re.transport.setType(TransportSettings.TYPE_PRESCRIBED)
        elif mode == 'RECHESTERROSENBLUTH':
            ds.eqsys.n_re.transport.setType(TransportSettings.TYPE_RECHESTERROSENBLUTH)
            ds.eqsys.n_re.transport.setdBBFromDrr(D_scalar)
        elif mode == 'NONE':
            ds.eqsys.n_re.transport.setType(TransportSettings.TYPE_NONE)

        # Run simulation
        output = runiface(ds, f'output_radial_transport_{mode}_hottail_{hottail}.h5')
```
